GOLDFINCH BENGALURU
Goldfinch Bengaluru is the flagship hotel of the MRG Group. With a tasteful blend of comfort and modern design, it leaves a lasting impression on every guest. Located in the city centre, this boutique hotel is a preferred choice for both business travellers and tourists. The hotel features elegantly designed rooms spread over seven floors, offering guests a comfortable and sophisticated stay. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, ensuring a seamless experience for guests.
It houses two of MRG Group’s popular restaurants—Sana-di-ge, Coastal cuisine restaurant and The Kabab Studio, Live BBQ restaurant. The hotel also features a café called G77, a spacious banquet hall for meetings or events, and a well-equipped spa for personal care and relaxation

EXECUTIVE ROOM
The Executive Room is crafted for travelers who value efficiency without compromising on relaxation. With thoughtful touches, work-friendly corners, and a soothing atmosphere, it’s designed to keep you productive through the day - and well-rested through the night.
GOLD CLUB ROOM
The Gold Club Room is curated for those who appreciate the finer details. With added space, elegant finishes, and elevated comfort, it offers a calm retreat after a long day. Whether you're here for business or leisure, this room ensures a premium experience with exclusive access and thoughtful perks that make all the difference.
SUPERIOR ROOM
Designed with simplicity and warmth, the Superior Room offers everything you need - from a cozy bed to functional spaces that help you recharge. Whether you're here for business or a quick getaway, it’s the perfect place to unwind and reset.

DINING
Sana-di-ge is a tribute to the rich culinary heritage of India’s West Coast, where traditional recipes have been lovingly passed down through generations. Our journey began with a simple yet profound philosophy – bringing the comforting flavors of home-cooked coastal delicacies to our guests.
At the heart of Sana-di-ge lies the authentic touch of
Mrs. Asha Shetty, Director of MRG Group
, whose treasured family recipes form the soul of our menu. Our chefs, trained under her expert guidance, recreate dishes with the same precision, warmth, and devotion as a mother’s kitchen – offering a dining experience that feels like home.
At The Kabab Studio, every meal is a celebration of fire-kissed flavours and timeless grilling traditions.
From the irresistible aroma of charcoal-grilled skewers to the first bite of our perfectly seasoned kababs, we bring the art of live grilling to life. Paired with an indulgent buffet and a lively, welcoming ambience, The Kabab Studio offers a dining experience that’s bold, satisfying, and unforgettable.
G77 Café offers a refreshing space, perfect for those on the go or looking to unwind. Whether you’re stepping in for a quick meeting, attending a call, or catching up with a friend, the relaxed natural setting makes it easy to settle in. The menu features a variety of delicious bites, excellent coffee, and an unmatched selection of beverages – all thoughtfully crafted to suit different tastes and preferences. It’s your everyday café escape, made just right.
